notes.title: Update 1.3 - camera FOV settings
notes.content:
[h1]Hello wizards! [/h1]

In this update you can play with different camera FOV.
The pause menu contains a new option to change Camera FOV.

Have fun and have a magical day!

tags.feature: In this update you can play with different camera FOV.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello wizards! [/h1]

What you will find in this update:

[list]
[*] More performance improvements;
[*] Save progress system.
[/list]

How the save progress system works?

[list]
[*] After collecting a crystal the game saves automatically;
[*] When you reopen Lone Land, the game starts with the number of crystals collected last time and the corresponding buildings appear;
[*] The pause menu has a new option to restart the progress.
[/list]

Have a magical day!

notes.title: Update 1.1

tags.feature: Crystal counter in the pause menu (showing how many were taken and how many are available at the moment);

tags.balance_change: Adjust the location of some crystals, in order to make the achievement of 100 crystals more accessible and fair;

tags.feature: A warning when you try to exit the game that progress will be lost (the progress saving system is planned for the next update);
